text: A traveling merchant dropped his purse in the road, and you were the only one who saw it.

options.label: Ran it back to him before you'd thought about it
Took it to whoever kept order in town and let them sort it out
Kept it. Your family needed it more than he did
Kept it, and never told anyone, ever

text: You broke something in the house that mattered, and nobody knew it was you.

options.label: Fixed it yourself in secret and never brought it up
Said so straight away and took what came
Waited to see whether anyone would even notice
Let it stand. Someone else took the blame

text: Another child was getting beaten by the older ones, most days, and everyone knew.

options.label: Told an adult who could actually stop it
Fought them. Lost, mostly
Walked the other way. It wasn't yours to fix
Joined in enough not to be next

text: Whoever raised you had one rule you never understood the reason for.

options.label: Broke it once, just to see
Kept it anyway. They'd earned that much
Asked, and kept asking, until you got a real answer
Kept it in front of them and broke it everywhere else

text: A hard winter. There wasn't enough.

options.label: Kept exact count of who owed what, and collected later
Gave up your share more than once
Took what you could from people slower than you
Made sure your own ate first, whatever that cost anyone else

text: Someone you looked up to had been lying to you the whole time, and you found out.

options.label: Kept them close and stopped believing a word
Forgave them, mostly
Cut them off. No argument, no second conversation
Made sure they understood exactly what it had cost them
